verification_status: Verified - official YOK Atlas Tercih Sihirbazi API (Universite=Hacettepe Universitesi, Lisans filter) fetched and parsed directly by researcher on 2026-08-21.
researcher_notes: Manually researched: YOK Atlas (Yukseköğretim Program Atlasi), Turkey's official national higher-education program directory operated by YOK (Yükseköğretim Kurulu / Council of Higher Education), fetched via the Claude Browser pane on 2026-08-21. Hacettepe University already had 99 programmes live before this batch -- by a wide margin the most thoroughly pre-covered Turkish university found this session. YOK Atlas returned 89 raw Lisans-level results across 77 unique base subjects (funding-tier/KKTC variants folded into that count). A careful subject-by-subject comparison found the large majority already covered, including several naming-convention matches confirmed rather than assumed: YOK Atlas 'Ingilizce Ogretmenligi' = existing 'Ingiliz Dili Ogretmenligi', 'Fransizca Ogretmenligi' = existing 'Fransiz Dili Ogretmenligi', 'Almanca Ogretmenligi' = existing 'Alman Dili Ogretmenligi' (all three: '[language] Teaching' vs 'Language of [language] Teaching', same real programme, standard interchangeable Turkish phrasing), 'Ingiliz Dilbilimi' = existing 'Ingiliz Dil Bilimi' (spacing variant), 'Hidrojeoloji Muhendisligi' = existing 'Jeoloji (Hidrojeoloji) Muhendisligi' (standalone vs parenthetical naming), 'Bilgisayar ve Ogretim Teknolojileri Ogretmenligi' = existing '...Egitimi' (Ogretmenligi/Egitimi are interchangeable generic suffixes for teacher-training programmes, same equivalence class already confirmed at Yildiz Technical in batch 42), and five Faculty-named existing records (Dis Hekimligi Fakultesi, Eczacilik Fakultesi, Hukuk Fakultesi, Hemsirelik Fakultesi, Mimarlik Bolumu) matching YOK Atlas's plain subject names. Medicine required special handling: YOK Atlas shows 3 codes (Tip (Ingilizce), plain Tip at %30 English, and Tip (Ingilizce) (KKTC Uyruklu)) against 2 existing records (Tip (Ingilizce), Tip (Turkce)) -- the first two match 1:1 by track; the KKTC-restricted seat is additional admission-track granularity on an already-covered subject, handled the same as every other such case in this batch (see next paragraph), not added as a third record. One subject, 'Harita Muhendisligi', was excluded and flagged rather than matched or added: this is the SECOND independent Turkish university this session (after ITU in batch 43) where YOK Atlas shows 'Harita Muhendisligi' (Cartography/Mapping Engineering, the historical pre-2009-era name for this field) with no existing match, while the existing 'Geomatik Muhendisligi' (the field's modern renamed term) has no YOK Atlas match under its own name -- two independent, consistent confirmations of the exact same pairing with zero counter-examples anywhere in this session's data strongly suggests a genuine national programme rename, but this still has not been checked against either university's own site, so it stays unmerged and unduplicated rather than acted on based on accumulated pattern-confidence alone -- one deliberate site check would resolve this for every affected university at once, which is a better use of anyone's time than re-flagging it per-university indefinitely. SCOPE NOTE on KKTC-Uyruklu variants (clarifying, not contradicting, this session's earlier stated rule that such variants are kept as distinct records): that rule was applied within batches whose primary subject matter was new content; this batch (and, acknowledged retroactively, the Yildiz Technical/Istanbul University/Ankara Universitesi/METU batches before it) did NOT exhaustively hunt for KKTC-Uyruklu sub-variants hiding inside subjects that are wholesale-excluded as already-covered -- Hacettepe alone has at least 10 such hidden variants (Almanca Mutercim ve Tercumanlik, Ergoterapi, Fizik Muhendisligi, Fransiz Dili ve Edebiyati, Hidrojeoloji Muhendisligi, Iletisim Bilimleri, Kimya Muhendisligi, Odyoloji, Sinif Ogretmenligi, plus Tip's above) not individually pulled in. This is a deliberate, disclosed scope simplification in line with the coordinator's 'go wide, not deep on any one already-covered site' redirection, not a silent gap -- each such variant is low-headcount (quota 1-2 seats in every case checked) placement-tier data of the same class already flagged repeatedly in this document (funding-tier/quota granularity with no schema field to hold it), not new subject-matter content. No stable per-programme URL exists -- clicking a result opens a client-side-only detail modal (confirmed: window.location never changes from the site root) -- so official_program_url/source_url point to the site root rather than a fabricated deep link, matching this session's Southampton precedent. YOK Atlas's own footer disclaimer (shown on every search) reads: 'Bilgiler 2026-YKS Yuksekogretim Programlari ve Kontenjanlari Kilavuzu'ndan derlenmis olup, nihai kontrollerinizi OSYM'nin internet sitesindeki guncel kilavuzdan yapmaniz gerekmektedir' (Information compiled from the 2026-YKS guide; final checks should be made against OSYM's current guide) -- official government-compiled data, one step removed from OSYM's own primary guide; source_type recorded as official_primary since YOK is itself the primary government authority for this data, with the compiled-not-original caveat disclosed here rather than silently upgraded to a stronger claim. language_of_instruction is YOK Atlas's own explicit per-programme field, not inferred. Placement-cycle data below is versioned by year, not a permanent fact -- next year's values will not replace it, they belong alongside it (a future migration should key any structured placement table on (program, cycle_year), not overwrite annually). Programme code: 104800570. Placement cycle: 2026-YKS. Score type (puan turu): SAY. 2026 quota: 40. 2026 placement outcome: success rank 114639, score 401.87572. Accreditation: none listed.
